title: Name Changes on Multi-Domain Certificates
content:
Product change terms for SSL/TLS Certificates: adding names to and removing names from a certificate subscription.

## Section 1 — Terms in force

**1.1 Status.** Names may be added only while the subscription status is active, as shown on the subscription record for that subscription reference number.

**1.2 Products that take added names.** Names may be added only to a product whose price per added name per year is above zero, up to the product's largest number of names in total. Of the Harborline products this means the multi-domain products (Harborline DV Multi-Domain and Harborline EV Multi-Domain); a product whose price per added name is zero takes no added names.

**1.3 Effect on the certificate.** Adding or removing a name takes effect on a free reissue.

**1.4 Removal.** Removing a name never refunds anything.

| Change | Status needed | Product condition | Takes effect | Money |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| add a name | active | price per added name above zero; total names within the product's largest number of names | on a free reissue | billed |
| remove a name | not limited by these terms | any | on a free reissue | nothing refunded |

## Section 2 — Term no longer in force

"Each added name is billed the price per added name per year times the remaining days divided by 365, where remaining days are the calendar days from today to the subscription end date, rounded half up to the cent per line." This clause is **no longer in force** and is superseded by the current added-name rule.

## Section 3 — Figure these terms read

**Remaining days:** the calendar days from today to the subscription end date of the subscription concerned.

## Section 4 — Illustration (hypothetical)

A hypothetical Harborline DV Multi-Domain subscription in status active that already covers its included names and some extra names, with room left under the product's largest number of names: a name may be added, and it appears on the certificate at the next free reissue. If the customer later removes one of its names, the removal also takes effect on a free reissue and nothing is refunded for it. A Harborline DV Single Domain subscription takes no added name at all, its price per added name being zero.

superseded_clauses: Each added name is billed additional_name_price_per_year times the remaining days divided by 365, where remaining days are the calendar days from today to the subscription end date, rounded half up to the cent per line (name_addition_proration_basis).
